provenance.caveat: The Python subprocess start interface intentionally returns unsupported_capability. Native model-tool delegation is a separate, verified integration; see references/codex-runtime.md.

The Python subprocess status interface intentionally returns unsupported_capability. The authenticated native process channel separately exposes observed lifecycle state through harness process list/status.
The Python subprocess follow_up interface intentionally returns unsupported_capability. Genuine native follow-up to the same subagent has separate recorded trial evidence.

The Python subprocess cancel interface intentionally returns unsupported_capability. The native process channel separately withdraws permission; this does not guarantee termination of an already-running OS process.
The Python subprocess events interface intentionally returns unsupported_capability. Native hooks separately feed the shared process bus; recorded CLI trials qualify only their observed event paths.

notes: This declaration describes the adapter Python subprocess interface, not the native capabilities of Codex. Native model tools and the shared process channel have separate contracts and acceptance evidence in references/codex-runtime.md.
A codex exec process is a separate session, not a subagent of the current one; it is not a substitute for native delegation.
